decisionScope: Local candidate plus configured Production environment; not a deployed-release assertion. Deployment must use a separately approved commit.
rootCause: Root metadata alternates.canonical pointed to / and was inherited by service pages without overrides; Production NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL was absent.

fix.root: Retain metadataBase, remove inherited root canonical; home owns its canonical.
fix.helper: Strict HTTPS origin validation and explicit route canonicalMetadata helper; no canonical in Preview or with invalid configuration.
fix.effect: Production env applies to future builds; existing deployment was not rebuilt.
fix.noindex: Existing private/admin/write and unavailable-detail noindex preserved.

canonicalChecks.invalidSpot: Compiled generateMetadata throws NOT_FOUND; source regression checks noindex and absent canonical.
canonicalChecks.rootHtmlNormalization: Next.js serializes root canonical without trailing slash; equivalent origin URL.
canonicalChecks.dynamicHttp: NOT_RUN; compiled metadata executed directly, not HTTP status verification.

B.evidence: Verified production alias from prior candidate audit; Production site URL now configured

C.evidence: Prior Kakao registered-origin and Preview map evidence retained; key still present, no new production browser run

D.evidence: Self canonicals, 1424 sitemap URLs, robots and noindex pass; historical invalid-detail HTTP status remains unverified

E.evidence: Existing security headers retained; prior Vercel HSTS evidence; CSP deferred

F.evidence: Existing PWA cache boundaries unchanged; real-device registration unverified

G.evidence: Prior map/navigation evidence reused; no navigation or coordinate changes

H.evidence: Regression suite preserves 1405 spots, 1258 canonical fish, 38 condition profiles; no production data mutation

I.evidence: Production env inventory and fail-closed source defaults; build explicitly disabled all four backend flags

J.evidence: Prior desktop/mobile evidence reused; metadata-only change, no new responsive browser matrix

limitations.P2: Historical invalid Fishing Spot HTTP 200/noindex; not re-certified over HTTP. Compiled handler throws NOT_FOUND. Not an informational candidate blocker.
limitations.P3: Service Worker registration/install/update requires a real-device smoke check; no claim of completed device verification.
limitations.CSP: Not applied; unchanged and tracked as security follow-up.
limitations.HSTS: Already observed on Vercel response in prior audit; no repository HSTS change.
limitations.deployment: No production deploy; live canonical output is not claimed fixed yet.
limitations.worktree: Build includes pre-existing unrelated changes; select and review exact source scope before any future deployment.

history: production-deployment-candidate-v1.json retained unchanged as pre-fix evidence. This report supersedes its two candidate blockers only.
